topArticle.title: Five killed as Russia launches fresh aerial attacks across Ukraine
topArticle.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky accuses Russia of targeting civilian infrastructure, while Moscow reports that a warehouse was hit.
topArticle.titleJa: ロシアがウクライナ全土に新たな空襲を開始、5人死亡
topArticle.summary: ロシアがウクライナ全土に再び空爆を行い、5人が死亡。ゼレンスキー大統領は民間インフラを標的としたと非難。ロシアは倉庫への攻撃だったと報告。

topArticle.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
topArticle.description: Hundreds of homes and public buildings have been severely damaged with at least 51 people killed.

topArticle.summary: インドネシアで発生した地震により、数百の家屋や公共施設が損壊し、少なくとも51人が死亡。数千人が避難生活を送っており、救助活動が続いている。

topArticle.title: Cincinnati Open: Djokovic stunned by Tirante in second round
topArticle.description: Novak Djokovic struggled in the hot conditions and was ousted from Cincinnati Open in his first match since Wimbledon.
topArticle.titleJa: シンシナティ・オープン：ジョコビッチ、2回戦でティランテにまさかの敗戦
topArticle.summary: ノバク・ジョコビッチはシンシナティ・オープンの2回戦で苦戦し、ティランテに敗れ大会から姿を消した。

topArticle.title: At least 12 people killed in Polish tourist bus crash in Hungary
topArticle.description: By 3 a.m. on Sunday, the disaster management service reported that firefighters had so far rescued thirty-five people from the coach, while several passengers had been trapped beneath the vehicle.
topArticle.titleJa: ハンガリーでポーランド人観光バス事故、少なくとも12人死亡
topArticle.summary: ハンガリーで発生したポーランド人観光バスの事故で、少なくとも12人が死亡。消防隊が35人を救助しましたが、多数の乗客が車両の下敷きになっていました。

topArticle.title: Morocco prevents hundreds of migrants from crossing into Ceuta
topArticle.description: Moroccan security forces on Saturday broke up hundreds of migrants who had been hiding near Castillejos in a bid to reach Ceuta. The operation comes weeks after the mass crossing attempt that left 141 people dead.
topArticle.titleJa: モロッコが数百人の移民のセウタへの越境を阻止
topArticle.summary: モロッコ治安部隊がカスティリェホス付近で数百人の移民がセウタへ越境しようとするのを阻止。数週間前の越境試みで141人が死亡した事件に続くものです。

topArticle.title: Liechtenstein changes succession rule to allow women to ascend the throne
topArticle.description: The declaration was made on the national day of the central European country, which has a population of just 44,000.
topArticle.titleJa: リヒテンシュタイン、女性の王位継承を認める規則に変更
topArticle.summary: 中央ヨーロッパの小国リヒテンシュタインが建国記念日に、女性も王位を継承できるよう規則を変更すると発表した。

topArticle.title: Iran war: Qatar denies holding missing Iranian fighter pilots
topArticle.description: Tehran said the three pilots "were captured alive" by Qatari forces after their fighter jets were shot down in the early days of the US-Israel war with Iran. Qatar has denied Iran's claims.
topArticle.titleJa: イラン戦争：カタール、行方不明のイラン人戦闘機パイロット拘束を否定

topArticle.title: Lebanon says 11 killed in Israeli airstrikes
topArticle.description: Lebanon's prime minister denounced the attacks on villages in southern Lebanon for targeting civilians in their homes. Israel said it was firing on Hezbollah infrastructure.
topArticle.titleJa: レバノン、イスラエル空爆で11人死亡と発表
topArticle.summary: レバノン首相は、南部レバノンの村に対するイスラエルの攻撃を非難。イスラエルはヒズボラのインフラを標的としたと説明している。

topArticle.title: Australia to begin gun buyback scheme in response to Bondi shooting
topArticle.description: Australia will begin buying back guns in November, almost a year after a shooting at Sydney's Bondi killed 15 people.
topArticle.titleJa: オーストラリア、ボンダイ銃乱射事件を受け銃器買い戻し制度を開始へ
topArticle.summary: シドニーのボンダイでの銃乱射事件から約1年後、オーストラリアは11月に銃器買い戻し制度を開始する。

topArticle.title: Troops from North Korea to boost Russia's Ukraine forces
topArticle.description: Intelligence agencies report that North Korea is preparing to send up to 50,000 troops to Russia. But military experts doubt that this will make a fundamental difference in the course of Russia's war with Ukraine.
topArticle.titleJa: 北朝鮮軍、ロシアのウクライナ部隊を増強へ
topArticle.summary: 情報機関によると、北朝鮮が最大5万人の兵士をロシアに送る準備をしているが、軍事専門家はウクライナ戦争の状況に根本的な変化はないと見ている。

topArticle.title: How Germany supports recovery of Berlin Pride attack victims
topArticle.description: After a terrorist attack, public attention tends to focus primarily on the perpetrator. But what about the victims? What support can they expect? And what lies ahead for them?
topArticle.titleJa: ドイツがベルリンのプライド攻撃被害者の回復をどのように支援するか
topArticle.summary: テロ攻撃後、加害者に焦点が当たる中、ドイツがベルリンのプライド攻撃被害者に対しどのような支援を行い、彼らに何が待ち受けているのかを問う。

topArticle.title: Belgium battles record wildfire at German border
topArticle.description: A rapidly spreading wildfire in the High Fens nature reserve near Belgium's border with Germany has scorched around 2,700 hectares. The German town of Monschau has also warned residents of possible evacuation orders.
topArticle.titleJa: ベルギー、ドイツ国境で記録的な山火事と格闘
topArticle.summary: ベルギーとドイツ国境付近のハイフェンス自然保護区で急速に広がる山火事が発生し、約2,700ヘクタールが焼失。ドイツのモンシャウ市も避難命令の可能性を警告。

topArticle.title: Zimbabwe boat accident death toll hits 68 as 22 more bodies recovered
topArticle.description:
Eighteen children among the people killed after ferry capsized on Lake Kariba
Twenty-two more bodies have been recovered after a boat accident in Zimbabwe, taking the death toll to 68, police said on Saturday.
The ferry capsized on Tuesday on Lake Kariba, on the border with Zambia. An investigation has suggested it was overloaded when it turned over during heavy winds.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: ジンバブエのボート事故、死者数が68人に達する、さらに22体の遺体が回収される
topArticle.summary: ジンバブエのカリバ湖で発生したボート転覆事故により、死者数は68人に達しました。過積載と強風が原因とみられ、犠牲者には18人の子供が含まれています。

topArticle.title: American missionary kidnapped in Niger freed after nine months
topArticle.description:
Kevin Rideout, who was abducted by unknown assailants in Niamey, said to be in good health and in care of US officials
An American missionary who was kidnapped in Niger in October has been released, his organisation has said.
Serving in Mission International said Kevin Rideout “is in good health in the care of US officials” and would soon be reunited with his extended family.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: ニジェールで誘拐されたアメリカ人宣教師が9ヶ月ぶりに解放
topArticle.summary: ニジェールで昨年10月に誘拐されたアメリカ人宣教師ケビン・ライドアウト氏が解放されました。同氏は健康状態も良好で、米国当局の保護下にあるとのことです。

topArticle.title: DRC’s fast-growing Ebola outbreak spreads to sixth province
topArticle.description:
Man dies in Bas-Uele after travelling from Haut-Uele, as head of WHO says outbreak on track to be deadliest ever
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to a sixth province, officials have said, a day after the head of the World Health Organization said the outbreak was on track to surpass the deadliest in history, which killed at least 11,000 people more than a decade ago.
The current outbreak has killed more than 2,100 people out of more than 4,500 cases, according to the latest government figures released on Tuesday. At the same point in the 2014-16 outbreak in west Africa, the previous most deadly outbreak, 755 cases had been recorded, according to WHO data.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: コンゴ民主共和国の急速に拡大するエボラ出血熱、6番目の州に蔓延
topArticle.summary: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が6番目の州に拡大し、世界保健機関は史上最悪の流行になる可能性を警告しています。これまでに2,100人以上が死亡しています。

topArticle.title: French ambassador to CAR investigated over claims he hosted dozens of women
topArticle.description:
Disciplinary proceedings under way after security concerns raised over reported visits to official residence
France has opened disciplinary proceedings against its ambassador to Central African Republic over allegations of misconduct, after claims he brought dozens of women into his official residence, raising potential security concerns.
The investigation comes as Paris seeks to rebuild relations with CAR after their sharp deterioration in recent years amid Russia’s expanding influence in the former French colony.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: フランスの駐中央アフリカ共和国大使、数十人の女性を自宅に招いた疑惑で調査対象に
topArticle.summary: フランス政府は、駐中央アフリカ共和国大使が公邸に数十人の女性を招き、安全保障上の懸念が生じた疑惑を受け、懲戒手続きを開始しました。

topArticle.title: Canadian plasma clinics pause collections after deaths of two donors
topArticle.description:
Grifols, which runs private chain of clinics, to temporarily stop taking donations after new government investigation
A chain of private plasma donation clinics in Canada has said it is pausing collections after the deaths of two donors and a new government investigation into potential unsafe practices.
Grifols, a Spanish healthcare company which runs 17 clinics in Canada and is the country’s only private clinic for plasma donation, said it informed Health Canada of its decision to temporarily pause collections on Wednesday.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: カナダのプラズマ採血クリニック、ドナー2名の死亡を受け採血を一時停止
topArticle.summary: カナダのプライベートプラズマ採血クリニックが、ドナー2名の死亡と新たな政府調査を受け、採血を一時停止しました。安全性に関する懸念が浮上しています。

topArticle.title: More than a month after Venezuela’s earthquakes: ‘I’m not leaving here until my son is found’
topArticle.description: One month after the two earthquakes, thousands of relatives remain beside the collapsed buildings in La Guaira despite harsh conditions and insufficient support for search efforts.
topArticle.titleJa: ベネズエラ地震から1か月以上：「息子が見つかるまでここを離れない」
topArticle.summary: ベネズエラの地震から1か月以上経っても、数千人の家族が過酷な状況下で捜索支援不足の中、倒壊した建物のそばに留まっている。

topArticle.title: Former Mexican governor charged in case of 43 students who vanished in 2014
topArticle.description:
Ángel Aguirre indicted in case that rocked Mexico and became symbol of its brutal cartel violence
The former governor of Guerrero state in Mexico has been formally charged over his alleged involvement in the disappearance of 43 students in 2014, a case that has become a symbol of the country’s brutal cartel violence and government impunity.
Ángel Aguirre, who was arrested last week, is accused of forced disappearance and obstruction of justice for ordering the destruction of surveillance tapes that may have shed light on what happened to the students from the Ayotzinapa teacher training college on the night of 26 September 2014.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: 元メキシコ州知事、2014年に失踪した43人の学生事件で起訴される
topArticle.summary: メキシコの元ゲレロ州知事アンヘル・アギーレ氏が、2014年に43人の学生が失踪した事件に関与したとして正式に起訴されました。この事件はメキシコのカルテル暴力と政府の免責の象徴となっています。

topArticle.title: NATO fighter jets shoot down drone over Romania near Moldova border

topArticle.titleJa: NATO戦闘機がモルドバ国境付近のルーマニア上空でドローンを撃墜

topArticle.summary: ハロッズの元オーナーによる虐待被害者約140人のメールアドレスが人為的ミスで流出。英国警察が謝罪し、プライバシー侵害の深刻さが問われています。

topArticle.title: Lima Grand Prix 2026: Breakthrough victories on Day Two

topArticle.summary: エジプト人フォワードのモハメド・サラーがトルコのトラブゾンスポルでデビューし、カシムパシャとの試合は引き分けに終わった。

topArticle.title: 3-year-old girl rescued 100 hours after Colombia earthquake

topArticle.title: A burial row over Zambia's late president has turned its election into a hot contest

topArticle.title: Cocoa farmers in southeast Cameroon are adapting to EU regulations, but they still want a fair price
topArticle.description: “We produce certified cocoa respecting standards, which means we have learned to keep the environment, the people, and the cocoa bean healthy- harmony between nature, people, and cocoa.”

topArticle.title: Pardon for president's main rival in Chad

topArticle.title: Who are the Chawinga sisters leading Malawi's bid for Wafcon glory?

topArticle.title: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC

topArticle.title: Whose conservation, whose development? The Maasai struggle over land in northern Tanzania

topArticle.title: The right to nationality in Mozambique: The application of ‘Jus soli’ in the fight against statelessness

topArticle.title: Person fined after using foghorn to wake sleeping polar bear
topArticle.description: Under local regulations in the region, "it is forbidden to needlessly disturb, attract or pursue a polar bear".
topArticle.titleJa: 霧笛で眠るホッキョクグマを起こした人物が罰金
topArticle.summary: ある地域で、霧笛を使って眠っていたホッキョクグマを起こした人物が罰金を科された。地元規制では動物の不必要な妨害を禁止している。

topArticle.title: Dozens injured and thousands evacuated in Croatia wildfire
topArticle.description: Officials say the blaze, near the port town of Omis, is one of the worst in Croatia's history.
topArticle.titleJa: クロアチアでの森林火災で数十人が負傷、数千人が避難
topArticle.summary: クロアチアのオミシュ港町近くで発生した大規模森林火災により、数十人が負傷し、数千人が避難。史上最悪級の火災となっている。

topArticle.title: Discord ordered to suspend livestreams in Brazil
topArticle.description: Discord told the BBC it was "thoughtfully reviewing" the order by Brazil's data protection agency and it was "committed to user safety"
topArticle.titleJa: ディスコード、ブラジルでのライブストリーム停止を命じられる
topArticle.summary: ブラジルのデータ保護機関がディスコードに対し、ライブストリームの停止を命じた。同社は命令を検討中。

topArticle.title: 70 years on, Argentine court declares ‘Operation Massacre’ a crime against humanity
topArticle.description: The victims’ families testified in court for the first time: "We want justice served. Even though their killers are no longer here, I want the truth known.”
topArticle.titleJa: 70年を経て、アルゼンチン裁判所が「虐殺作戦」を人道に対する罪と宣言
topArticle.summary: 70年前の「虐殺作戦」が人道に対する罪と認定され、被害者家族が初めて法廷で証言し、真実と正義を求めた。

topArticle.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
topArticle.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.
topArticle.titleJa: 市民権を武器化する：ニカラグアにおける反対意見の封殺
topArticle.summary: ニカラグアで、権威主義的な政権が市民権剥奪を主張し、反対意見を封殺する実態を考察する。

topArticle.title: Indian solar mission's new findings throw light on enduring Sun mysteries
topArticle.description: Why is the Sun's corona millions of degrees hotter than its surface? And how does it maintain its inexplicably high temperature?
topArticle.titleJa: インドの太陽探査ミッション、太陽の長年の謎に新たな光を当てる
topArticle.summary: インドの太陽探査ミッションが、太陽のコロナが表面より数百万度も高温である理由や、その異常な高温をどのように維持しているかといった長年の謎に新たな発見をもたらした。

topArticle.title: 'Unprecedented' rain in Japan kills eight people
topArticle.description: The storm cut power to more than 20,000 households and left 7,000 people stranded at Tokyo's Narita airport.
topArticle.titleJa: 日本で「前例のない」豪雨により8人が死亡
topArticle.summary: 日本を襲った「前例のない」豪雨により8人が死亡、2万世帯以上が停電し、東京の成田空港では7,000人が足止めされるなど、甚大な被害が出た。

topArticle.title: South Korea's Incheon airport becomes world's busiest for global traffic
topArticle.description: The airport said diversions caused by the Middle East conflict helped boost its traffic, while Heathrow was ranked second.
topArticle.titleJa: 韓国の仁川空港、世界で最も混雑する国際線空港に
topArticle.summary: 韓国の仁川空港が国際線トラフィックで世界一となり、中東紛争による航空路の変更がその交通量を増加させる一因となったと報じられた。ヒースロー空港は2位にランクされた。

topArticle.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
topArticle.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
topArticle.titleJa: リトアニア、途上国と後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上に3万ユーロを拠出
topArticle.summary: リトアニアは2026年に3万ユーロを拠出し、途上国や後発開発途上国の政府職員向け貿易研修プログラムを支援する。

topArticle.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
topArticle.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
topArticle.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年までのWTO加盟目標を再確認し、継続的な関与に感謝
topArticle.summary: ウズベキスタンは、2026年までのWTO加盟プロセス完了に向けた決意を再確認し、加盟国に継続的な関与への感謝を表明した。
